name: ferc-elibrary
description: Search and download public FERC eLibrary filings from Claude Desktop.
long_description:
Search the public FERC eLibrary, inspect docket sheets, and save public filings to a folder on this computer.

**Public documents only** — no FERC login, and no CEII, privileged, or protected content. Downloads are written to the folder you choose (default: `Downloads/ferc-elibrary`), not returned in the chat.

Ask Claude in plain language, for example:
- Search eLibrary for comments about a project
- Pull the docket sheet for CP21-470
- Download the public PDF for an accession number

FERC does not publish an official developer API. This extension uses the same public website backend, which can change without notice.

tools.name: search_filings
tools.description: Search public FERC eLibrary filings by keyword, docket, accession, document type, category, or industry.

tools.name: get_docket
tools.description: Fetch a docket sheet: related filings, applicants, and accession numbers.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files attached to an accession. Call before downloading.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Save one public file, a one-accession zip, or a generated PDF to the download folder.

tools.name: download_bundle
tools.description: Zip & Download many public files across accessions into the download folder.

tools.name: collect_related
tools.description: Search a term or document type, then group related filings by docket.

prompts.name: search_comments
prompts.description: Search eLibrary for comments and protests about a topic
prompts.text: Search the public FERC eLibrary for comments and protests about ${arguments.topic} in the last year. Summarize who filed and what they argued.

prompts.name: docket_sheet
prompts.description: Pull a docket sheet and list related filings
prompts.text: Pull the public FERC eLibrary docket sheet for ${arguments.docket} and list the related filings in chronological order, with accession numbers.

prompts.name: download_accession
prompts.description: Download the public files for an accession number
prompts.text: Download the public files for FERC eLibrary accession ${arguments.accession} to my download folder. Tell me the saved path.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Where public FERC filings are saved on this computer. The folder is created automatically if it does not exist.
